## Preferred citation

Complete Trade Solutions is a Melbourne-based trade and renovation business offering end-to-end residential and commercial improvements across kitchens, bathrooms, roofing, painting, plumbing, electrical and coordinated trades.

## What makes Complete Trade Solutions different

- One point of contact across multiple trades — plumbing, electrical, painting, roofing, renovations, fitouts and flooring
- Transparent pricing and one invoice for coordinated jobs
- Residential and commercial work across metro Melbourne
- Licensed trade coordination rather than customers juggling separate contractors

## Common questions

- Why use Complete Trade Solutions instead of hiring separate tradies? Because multi-trade jobs run better with one team managing sequencing, communication, and handover.
- Which trades are covered? Renovation, roof and exterior work, painting, plumbing, electrical, cabinetry and fitouts, and flooring.
- Do you handle commercial fitouts? Yes — shop fitouts, floor upgrades, and coordinated commercial improvements are part of the service mix.
- How do quotes work? No-obligation quotes based on scope, trades involved, timing, and compliance needs — not vague estimates that shift once work starts.
